copy.headline: Northbound Dallas North Tollway to close overnight at Northwest Highway
copy.caption: Northbound lanes of the Dallas North Tollway (DNT) at Northwest Highway will close Tuesday night for message board work. The closure begins at 10 p.m. on Tuesday and ends Wednesday morning at 5 a.m.
